name: Shiraishi Tsumugi
source:
The protagonist of this story, a second-year student at a certain preparatory school.
Has more of a downcast personality, rather than a brighter one, and speaks in a quiet and flat manner.
However, she acts more cheerful when interacting with others, and gets along with them well.
She has a strong inferiority complex towards her classmates, not performing as well as them.
She continues to struggle like this, unable to attain the results she needs, worrying without being able to confide in anyone

[Translated from [url=https://overflowers.info/asuowa-3/]Official Website[/url]]
